item.title: If Sexy Isn’t the Goal Anymore, Why Does Red Lipstick Still Look Good at 60?
item.description: When did you stop wearing red lipstick? Was it gradual? One day it just felt like “too much”? Did someone make a comment – well-meaning or otherwise – that lodged itself quietly in your mind? Or did life simply get busy, practical, serious… and red felt frivolous?
